Definition
[Simple function] ↗ def:sigma-algebra 1. appE:E.5-def-1\group Vector-Valued Integration

A function $s:[0,T]\to X$ is simple if \[ (5)\qquad s(t)=\sum _{i=1}^m\chi _{E_i}(t)u_i \qquad (0\leq t\leq T), \] where each $E_i\subset [0,T]$ is Lebesgue measurable and $u_i\in X$.
